# EduHub — Design Notes

## Source
- ColorLib: OneSchool (https://colorlib.com/wp/template/oneschool/)
- Preview: https://preview.colorlib.com/theme/oneschool/

## Section order
1. Navbar (logo, nav links)
2. Hero (bg image, "Learn From The Expert", "Admission Now")
3. Sign Up section
4. Courses (6 cards, carousel with prev/next)
5. Programs ("Our Programs")
6. Stats ("We Are Excellent In Education", 2 stats)
7. Testimonials ("Strive for Excellent" carousel)
8. Education ("Education is life" with stats)
9. Teachers (4 profiles with circular avatars)
10. Why Choose Us (6 reason cards)
11. Footer (white bg, Component Dock)

## Tokens
- Primary: #7971ea (soft purple) | Font: Muli
- Buttons: 30px radius | Cards: 7px | Avatars: 50%
- Light bg: #f4f5f9 | White: #ffffff
